adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the `afterModel` hooks that previously returned the `findMembers()` promise (admin `admin_group_route.js` and user-facing `group-members.js.es6`) and now calls `model.findMembers();` in `setupController` without returning/awaiting it. Since `Discourse.Group#findMembers` is async (AJAX) and mutates `members`, `user_count`, `limit`, and `offset` on the model, a rejected request will no longer block the transition or surface an error via the route promise chain, leaving whatever prior `members`/pagination state is already on the cached model (or empty/null) rendered in the template (`{{each member in members}}`, `{{user_count}}`, `{{currentPage}}/{{totalPages}}`). This is a behavior regression that can produce empty/stale member lists with no admin feedback on failure.
